therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: NMDA receptor (memantine); oxidative stress / free radicals (vitamin E)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: NMDA receptor antagonism (memantine); antioxidant free-radical scavenging (vitamin E)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: neuroprotection against excitotoxicity and oxidative-stress-mediated neuronal loss
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: ADCS/ADL Inventory change from baseline over 48 months

results.effect_size: Mean difference (Vitamin E vs placebo) = 3.15 ADCS/ADL units (95% CI: 0.92–5.39), p=0.03; Memantine vs placebo p=0.40; Combination vs placebo p=0.49
subgroup_findings: Vitamin E monotherapy showed statistically significant slowing of functional decline on ADCS/ADL vs placebo (p=0.03)
Memantine monotherapy did not significantly differ from placebo on ADCS/ADL (p=0.40)
Combination arm did not significantly differ from placebo on ADCS/ADL (p=0.49)
No significant differences on MMSE across all arms (all p=0.84)
No significant differences on ADAS-cog across all arms
No significant differences on NPI across all arms (all p=0.94)
Caregiver Activity Survey: Vitamin E showed significant reduction vs placebo at average (p=0.03 for one analysis); Combination arm showed significant increase vs placebo (p=0.03 for one analysis)
Dependence Scale time-to-event: no significant differences (p=0.69)
All-cause mortality: no significant differences across arms (p=0.31, 0.47, 0.80)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were distributed across arms with no clear pattern of excess in any single arm
Atrial fibrillation occurred in 3/154 Vitamin E + Memantine and 3/152 Placebo patients
Acute myocardial infarction occurred in 3/155 Memantine patients vs 1/152 Placebo

dose_info.dose: Vitamin E: 1000 IU twice daily (2000 IU/day); Memantine: 10 mg twice daily (20 mg/day)
dose_info.schedule: Vitamin E: twice daily; Memantine: titrated over 4 weeks to 10 mg twice daily
dose_info.dose_modifications: Memantine titrated over 4 weeks: 5 mg QAM week 1, 5 mg BID week 2, 15 mg/day week 3, 20 mg/day from week 4

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Combining NMDA receptor antagonism with antioxidant therapy was hypothesized to additively protect neurons via complementary neuroprotective pathways, but the combination arm did not outperform vitamin E monotherapy on the primary endpoint
modulation_entries.citation: Mean Difference (Net) = 1.76 (95% CI: -0.48–4.00), p = 0.49 for combination vs placebo on ADCS/ADL, compared to 3.15 (p=0.03) for vitamin E alone

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Adding antioxidant vitamin E to memantine was hypothesized to enhance neuroprotection, but the combination did not improve outcomes beyond memantine monotherapy
modulation_entries.citation: Mean Difference (Net) = 1.76 (95% CI: -0.48–4.00), p = 0.49 for combination vs placebo on ADCS/ADL, compared to 1.98 (p=0.40) for memantine alone
